newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA, June 23 - Durres - Seven vessels in port discharging of which 3 wheat flour, 3 general cargo, 1 bagged cement. 3 Vessels awaiting berth in roads for discharging bulk wheat and wheat flour.

BULGARIA, June 23 - Varna - east - One vessel loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load. West - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Bourgas - East - 11 Vessels due, 1 loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 under repair/drydock. West - 4 Vessels loading at berth. Tankers, 2 loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Bourgas - Five vessels operating of which 4 loading steel, 1 discharging coal. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load, 1 cars, 2 oil products. 2 To discharge, 1 fish, 1 crude oil. 8 Vessels due of which 5 to load, 2 steel, 1 zinc, 1 timber, 1 concentrate. 3 To discharge of which 1 coal, 1 sugar, 1 iron ore. Varna - 49 Vessels operating of which 32 loading, 1 cellulose/granite, 3 cement, 1 glass, 2 scrap, 8 soda, 7 fertiliser, 3 clier, 2 containers, 2 quartz sand, 1 general, 1 kaoline, 1 constructions.

CYPRUS, June 24 - Limassol - Vessels due on 25/6, 3 containers, 1 conventional vessel, 5 passenger, no delays expected. 5 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 4 conventional vessels discharging at berth. Larnaca - Vessels due on 25/6, 1 container vessel, 1 conventional vessel, no delays expected. 1 Container vessel discharging/loading at berth.
POLAND, June 24 - Szczecin - Seventy vessels due. 30 Vessels loading at berth, 32 discharging at berth, 16 under repair/drydock.

PORTUGAL, June 23 - Lisbon - 32 Vessels due, 96 in port, 5 loading at berth, 17 unloading at berth. 16 Loading and unloading at berth, 6 loading at anchorage, 2 unloading at anchorage, 3 bunkering, 14 under repair/drydock, 4 awaiting orders, 27 miscellaneous craft. Leixoes - Vessels operating, 9 general cargo, 5 container vessels. No vessels awaiting berth. Places vacant, 7 piers with cranes, 1 pier without. June 24 - Setubal - Four vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 6 for discharging, 5 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock. Sines - Vessels operating, 1 discharging chemical naphtha, 1 discharging/loading fuel oil, 1 loading propane, 1 vessel waiting to discharge coal. Vessels due, 3 to discharge coal, 1 to discharging propane, 1 each to load propylene, ethylene, aromatics mixture, gasoline/gasoil/jet fuel.

ROMANIA, June 24 - Constantza - 32 Vessels operating of which 17 generals loading, 5 bulkers (3 loading, 2 discharging), 6 bagged chemicals loading, 1 tanker loading, 1 cement loading, 2 containers loading/discharging. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 generals for loading, 1 bagged chemicals for loading, 2 tankers for loading. Constantza Sud (Agigea) - Six vessels operating of which 4 loading generals, 2 bulkers discharging. Mangalia - Two loading generals, 2 bulkers loading. Midia - Four vessels loading livestock.

RUSSIA, June 23 - FAR EAST ports - Vladivostok - 14 Vessels in port of which 1 passenger vessel, 6 vessels loading (1 timber, 4 metal, 1 general cargo), 1 container discharging/loading, 6 waiting. Nakhodka - 13 Vessels in port of which 6 loading (3 metal, 3 timber), 7 waiting. Vostochniy - 12 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (3 timber, 2 coal, 2 metal), 2 containers discharging/loading, 3 waiting. Posyet - No vessels in port. Zarubino - No vessels in port. No delays. No congestion.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Eight vessels operating of which 2 alumina, 2 steel, 1 apatite, 1 non-ferrous metal, 1 cabotage, 1 coal. No vessels waiting, 8 due during the week of which 7 loaders (1 coal, 5 apatite, 1 iron ore pellets), 1 alumina discharger.

BALTIC ports - Kaliningrad - Commercial port - 9 Vessels operating of which 7 loading (1 fertiliser, 1 empty container vessel, 1 coke, 1 coal, 1 hardboard, 1 ferro-alloys, 1 non-ferrous metal), 2 discharging (1 pellets, 1 malt). 3 Vessels waiting, 5 due. Fishery port - 4 Vessels operating of which 3 discharging (1 frozen fish, 1 animal food, 1 fruit), 1 loading oil, 5 vessels due. St. Petersburg - 16 Vessels operating of which loading, 4 non-ferrous, 2 fertiliser, 1 steel, 1 equipment, 1 cast iron, 2 containers, 1 scrap. Discharging, 1 frozen chicken, 1 container, 1 rice, 1 copper ore. 14 Vessels awaiting operations, 17 due.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - 17 Vessels operating of which 10 loading, 3 scrap, 1 bulk cement, 2 steel, 1 urea, 1 saltpetre, 2 non-ferrous metals. 7 Vessels discharging, 2 rice, 3 bulk sugar, 2 various. 23 Vessels waiting in roads of which 11 to load, 1 coal, 3 steel, 2 scrap, 2 aluminium, 1 logs, 1 zinc, 1 cast iron. 12 To discharge, 6 bulk sugar, 4 bagged rice, 1 frozen meat, 1 onions. 43 Vessels due of which 36 to load, 2 scrap, 11 steel, 2 tin, 1 copper, 1 zinc, 1 copper cathodes, 15 coal, 2 fertiliser, 1 equipment. 6 To discharge, 1 bulk sugar, 1 palm oil, 2 citrus, 1 luggage, 1 wine, 1 to discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - June 24 - 2 Vessels loading diesel oil, crude oil. 3 Tankers waiting in roads to load crude oil, 4 due to load crude oil.

SLOVENIA, June 23 - Koper - 11 Vessels berthed of which 3 containers loading/discharging, 5 general cargo loading sawn timber, paper, paint, cranes, 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 1 bulk carrier discharging chrome concentrate, 1 livestock vessel loading bulls, 1 US aircraft anchored. 12 Vessels due during next 2 days of which 6 containers to load/discharge, 1 ferry to load/discharge cars/trucks, 2 car carriers to load/discharge cars, 1 livestock vessel to load bulls, 2 bulk carriers to discharge alumina and salt, no delays expected.

SPAIN, June 24 - Cadiz - 26 Vessels operating of which 3 ro/ro, 1 sand, 2 semolina, 3 shipbuilding material, 1 oil, 1 wheat, 1 container vessel, 1 clinker, 13 under repair, no delays. Aviles - Five vessels in port of which 3 loading (2 steel products, 1 general cargo). 2 Discharging (1 fertiliser, 1 alumina). Gijon - Three vessels in port of which 1 loading cement, 2 discharging iron ore and coal. No delays or congestion. Pasajes - 14 Vessels in port of which 5 discharging scrap, 1 each discharging magnesite, fertiliser, granite, 1 discharging/loading cars, 2 loading steel, 3 under repair. No delays. Sagunto - 25 Vessels operating of which 9 discharging steel products, 1 discharging timber, 3 ro/ro discharging/loading general cargo, 2 discharging/loading steel products, 1 each discharging bulk fertiliser, plumb, bulk ammonia, cinders, 2 loading steel products, 1 ro/ro loading general cargo, 1 ro/ro discharging general cargo, 1 discharging/loading feldesphat. 1 Vessel outside commercial wharf discharging c

TURKEY, June 23 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 14 Vessels operating of which 5 containers, 7 dry cargo, 2 ro/ro. No berthing delays. Galata - 9 Cargo/passenger vesls operating. Port congested. Ambarli - 13 Vessels operating. No berthing delays.

UKRAINE, June 23 - Mariupol - 13 Vessels operating of which 11 loading, 4 steel, 5 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 pig iron, 1 loading/discharging containers, 1 cargo not nominated. 9 Vessels waiting in roads of which 7 to load, 3 steel, 2 sulphur, 1 debars, 1 coal, 1 to load, 1 to load/discharge containers. 28 Vessels due of which 19 to load, 5 coal, 5 fertiliser, 8 steel, 1 fire clay. 8 To discharge, 5 containers, 1 equipment, 1 combines, 1 alumina, 1 to discharge/load containers. Odessa - 15 Vessels operating of which 6 loading, 4 metal, 1 paper, 1 crude oil. 4 Discharging, 1 containers, 1 citrus, 1 sugar, 1 diesel oil, 2 passenger vessels, 2 vessels waiting owners' notification, 2 repair. 4 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load, 1 sugar, 1 steel, 1 fuel oil, 1 waiting. 19 Vessels due of which 9 to load, 7 metal, 1 crude oil, 1 fuel oil. 9 To discharge, 1 diesel oil, 6 containers, 1 sugar, 1 general cargo. 1 To discharge/load containers. YUGOSLAVIA, June 24 - Bar - 12 Vessels berthed of which 2 discharging bananas, 1 discharging anodes, 1 discharging gasoline. 2 Loading timber, 3 loading steel coils, 2 loading acet acid, 1 loading aluminium. Zelenika/Bijela - One vessel laid up, 3 under repair.
